landing.how.title: How it works
landing.how.1: Talk by voice or text: the professor answers briefly and hands the question back to you.

landing.how.3: Choose the lens of your tradition, without hiding the others. Maps, timelines, lessons, sermons and review ready to use.

reh.help: Rehearse the sermon out loud. I transcribe it, measure the time and pace, and give feedback on your outline. Rehearsal is practice: it doesn't have to be perfect.
reh.consent.title: Record your rehearsal
reh.consent.body: To analyze the rehearsal I need to record your voice and transcribe it. The audio is deleted as soon as the analysis ends; only the transcript and results are kept, and only you see them. You can choose to keep the recording for each rehearsal and delete everything whenever you want.

paths.mine.help: Answer in 20 seconds and the professor builds a path just for you: it starts with the clearest texts, alternates narrative, teaching and poetry, points to Christ and has a review every 7 days.
paths.mine.remake.help: Keeps the days you have already done and rebuilds the rest with what you asked for now.
paths.mine.goal: What do you want from the Word?
paths.mine.role: Who are you in the study?
paths.question: Question of the day
account.voicesource.server: Professor's voice (the same on all devices)
account.voicesource.device: Device voice (no accent, starts instantly; quality depends on the phone)
account.voicesource.help: Try both and keep the one that sounds best on your device.
account.voicesource.auto: Automatic (uses the device's natural voice, like Antonio on Edge, if available)
study.external.help: This was not in the app's library. The professor read the page below and only states what it says; worth checking at the source:
reader.title: Bible
reader.version.choose: Choose the Bible version to begin
reader.version.hint: You can change the version whenever you want; the text, marks and notes stay with you.
reader.select.hint: Tap verses to choose them: mark, annotate, share or understand.
reader.error: I couldn't open this chapter. Try again.
help.title: Understand the passage
help.teacher.loading: The professor is preparing the explanation…

help.chat: Talk with the professor about this passage
help.none: There is nothing more than the text for this passage in the app's sources.

note.placeholder: Write what you understood, a question, an application…

notes.empty: No notes with these filters. To take a note, open the Bible, tap a verse and choose Note.
